title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today (realistic)
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. Gives the date of birth in two parts: first 'the fourteenth of March', then when asked '1988'. Gives the last four digits in two parts: first 'four four', then 'seven one'. Asks once whether this call is a scam. Then says he can pay the full amount today, saying the amount in words. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: both security questions passed before get_account
the word 'collections' is not said before identity is verified
text-message sentence said after the promise

title: Wants a date after the deadline (realistic)
script: Verified. Before giving the date of birth asks 'is this about my car?' and then answers. Says her salary arrives on the sixth of November, in words, and she can pay then. Asks whether she is talking to a robot. Accepts the latest possible date when it is offered.
checks: her own date is not counted as a refusal
promise date is the late-band deadline, 23 October
agent says it is a digital assistant when asked

title: Full amount is too much, accepts the floor (realistic)
script: Verified. Says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the minimum payment, first saying 'on the twentieth, sorry, I mean this Friday'. Confirms.
checks: agent never asks how much she can pay
minimum payment offered once, with the note that the rest stays overdue

title: A vague period, then a holiday (realistic)
script: Verified. Talks about his day before most answers. Cannot pay today. Says 'after my cousin's wedding, the week after next'. When asked for the exact day, says Monday the twenty-sixth. Accepts the next business day when it is offered.
checks: agent asks once for the exact day
the agent does not accept 26 October and offers the next business day
promise recorded for Tuesday 27 October, inside the early-band deadline

title: The promise service fails on the first call (realistic)
script: Verified. Says every number in words. Cannot pay today. Agrees to pay the full amount this Friday and confirms.
checks: exactly one promise in the ledger after the retry
agent does not say 'recorded' before a successful call

title: One date for both, but the deadlines differ (realistic)
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Wants to pay both on the thirtieth of October, said in words. Asks why the loan has a different date. Accepts when told the loan has an earlier latest date.
checks: credit card recorded on 30 October (early band, inside its deadline)
loan recorded on its own deadline, 23 October
